HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Word Wipe - Free Online Puzzle Game
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Word Wipe is a quick and entertaining puzzle game with a straightforward idea: connecting tiles of individual letters into lines to form words. Letters can be used all around and from any direction. The letters vanish from the grid once you put them together to form a word.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Look for words on the board to begin playing Word Wipe.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: To remove the tiles, choose the word's individual letters.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: The letters from above take the place of the tiles as they vanish.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Word Wipe offers fast-paced gameplay that keeps you entertained.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Form words in any direction with the letters available on the grid.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Each level has a time limit, adding to the challenge and excitement.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: As letters vanish, new combinations appear, creating unique opportunities.
